caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher with a brown and reddish marbled coloration. The pitcher has a broad body, a pronounced spout, and a handle shaped to resemble a bird’s head, possibly a swan or goose, attached at the rim and upper body. The upper portion of the pitcher is decorated with embossed designs of grape clusters and leaves encircling the vessel. The central and lower part of the pitcher’s body displays a relief composition depicting several human figures wearing hats and coats, walking together and carrying buckets or baskets, accompanied by a cart with two large wheels. The cart appears to be filled with objects, possibly referencing a harvest. The background is a plain tan color, perforated with a thin, hand-drawn rectangular border. The signature “Charlotte Spaeth” appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
